name: Romazzino
positioning: Beachfront Belmond hotel on the Costa Smeralda in Sardinia, with a private sandy beach, villas with dedicated pools, and a children's club
best_for: Beach-focused travelers who want a private sandy beach and two pools
Families who want a children's club
Couples marking a honeymoon or an intimate celebration

facts.text: The hotel's architecture is by Michele Busiri Vici.
The hotel has one seawater pool and one freshwater pool.
The hotel has a spa called Romazzino Spa.
The hotel has an open-air gym and a Pilates studio.
The hotel has tennis and padel courts.
The hotel has a children's club.
The hotel hosts intimate ceremonial weddings and blessings, honeymoons and family celebrations.
The hotel is a 40-minute drive from Olbia Costa Smeralda Airport.

highlights.text: Romazzino was founded by the Aga Khan IV and first opened its doors in the 1960s.
The hotel has a private sandy beach with views of the La Maddalena archipelago.
The hotel offers independent villas with dedicated pools.
Restaurant La Terrasse offers panoramic fine dining.
Éntu e Mari is a relaxed beachside grill.

considerations.text: The hotel is a 40-minute drive from Olbia Costa Smeralda Airport.
WhataHotel notes seasonal operation with limited availability outside the summer months.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the Porto Cervo location.
